status: Documentation of the frozen prompt and applied qualitative rubric; taxonomy written after the primary run, not a new pre-registered metric or modified generation protocol

label_rule.word: Defensible lexical units, with numbers/IDs/URLs/abbreviations/internal apostrophes/hyphens intact; separate punctuation and whitespace; combining marks stay with their base
label_rule.phrase: Consecutive local constituents such as NP, predicate+negation/modality, quantity+unit, PP or short conditional constituent; multiple acceptable analyses, including unresolved attachments
label_rule.budgets: 1..32 phrases, 1..12 explicit child strings per phrase, <=64 Unicode code points per phrase; singleton passthrough allowed and not claimed compression
label_rule.raw: Concatenate all strings without added separators to reconstruct the original text byte-faithfully through UTF-8; no normalization, omission, translation or correction
label_rule.visibility: Whole supplied input is legitimately known; source excerpt completion is not true document EOF; no early stream action forcing

hard_checks: JSON shape/keys and nested string/array counts
exact code-point sequence and original UTF-8 reconstruction
sequential coverage, ordered two-level references and derived cp/byte spans
words containing mixed whitespace and non-whitespace
child starting with combining mark or ZWJ
output token-cap truncation from server finish_reason
hard_check_limits: No full linguistic dictionary, universal grapheme segmenter, comprehensive punctuation recognizer or semantic proof. Chinese multiword children with no spaces and all-singleton phrases can pass. Exact retained words do not certify the future latent, decoder or model's understanding.
qualitative_standards: Read the actual source and selected raw output, including rejected cases
Judge lexical granularity consistently but allow defensible Chinese compounds and ambiguous word boundaries
Look for useful local groups rather than paragraph/clause dumping, mechanical budget cuts or all-singleton degeneration
Track who did what to whom; negation, conditions and time scope; signs, decimal precision, units and identifiers
Cross-phrase relations are permitted; do not require every related fact in one huge node
Allow alternative analyses for telescope attachment and lexical compounds; do not score against an invented unique gold
Separate actual omitted/changed text, boundary risks and preferences; do not infer a numerical/role error merely from a cross-node relation

taxonomy.name_zh: 原文改写／遗漏（非纯排版）
examples: Qwen3.6 pilot:quoted-instruction loses the final clause
GLM pilot:zh-contrast omits the first 都
GLM expansion:005 reorders 不是说 to 说不是
taxonomy.interpretation: Actual source coverage/order failures; a function-word omission is not automatically a proved logical reversal, but cannot be silently repaired

examples: Qwen3.6 pilot:zh-quantity changes Chinese comma to ASCII
Qwen3.8 pilot:whitespace changes NBSP
GLM pilot:en-lexical omits all spaces and many other cases omit punctuation
taxonomy.interpretation: Hard raw failure, distinct from linguistic grouping quality; preserved punctuation internal to abbreviations does not excuse missing separators

examples: Qwen3.6 pilot:unicode breaks scientist emoji and inserts newlines
Qwen3.6 expansion:006 normalizes decomposed Cafe accent
Qwen3.8 expansion:006 detaches the accent from Cafe
taxonomy.interpretation: Distinguish changed raw characters from original text retained with an invalid combining boundary; GLM preserving emoji does not excuse unrelated whitespace loss

examples: Qwen3.6 pilot:zh-condition treats 丙先确认。 as one word
Qwen3.8 pilot:en-attachment glues telescope. together
GLM pilot:en-numbers splits + from 1,234.50; zh:utf-8 uses 已经是 as a word
taxonomy.interpretation: Some are hard protected-span failures; others require qualitative review. 生命科学 or 保留位 as compounds are not rejected merely for differing from a finer analysis

examples: Qwen3.6 MDN en:unicode puts the paragraph in one phrase
Qwen3.8 expansion:002 outputs all singleton phrases
Qwen3.8 MDN zh:unicode separates 很困难 from 的，
Both Qwens expansion:003 cut after until
taxonomy.interpretation: Hard legality is insufficient; singleton passthrough is legal but supplies no local grouping benefit, and node ratios including spaces are not semantic compression

examples: All three selected pilot:zh-role outputs retain roles, 没有 and 17.3, though GLM loses punctuation
Qwen3.8 selected pilot:zh-condition retains the three condition/consequence/exception clauses
GLM zh-contrast 都 omission and signed-number splitting are scope/quantity-boundary risks
GLM expansion:005 changes the relative position of 不是 and 说, a confirmed source-order rewrite involving negation
taxonomy.interpretation: No confirmed role swap or changed numeric value in the reviewed primary role/quantity examples; not an all-100 semantic guarantee. The supplementary negation rewrite is a distinct scope risk, not dismissed as formatting. Do not count retained text as proof of latent semantic preservation

count_policy: Categories overlap and examples are diagnostic, not mutually exclusive error-rate estimates. Hard-check counts, unblinded Codex judgments and independent human gold are distinct; no human gold exists in this run.
